shots.line: A bowl of candy, and a sign: please take one.
shots.scene: night porch wide: adult by the door, witch + ghost + blue kid at the bowl, slow push

shots.line: When someone is watching, fifty-seven percent take just one.
shots.scene: same porch, kids take one each, pill counts to 57 %

shots.line: But when the watcher fades away… only eight percent do.
shots.scene: adult fades to invisible, hooded kid alone looks around, grabs more; pill drops to 8 %

shots.line: Grown-ups are no different. Take an office honesty box.
shots.scene: office kitchenette, three colleagues: kettle, mugs, PAY HERE box; chapter title

shots.line: Swap the flowers on the poster for a pair of eyes, and payments almost triple.
shots.scene: push in on the poster: flowers become eyes; stat card FLOWERS vs EYES ≈3x + citation

shots.line: Paper eyes. That's all it takes.
shots.scene: close-up: mustard hoodie looks sideways at the eyes, sly; hand on hip

shots.line: So what would you do… if you were truly invisible?
shots.scene: farm stand at sunset, an invisible outline reaches for an apple, pay box waits
park at dusk, friends on a bench, invisible eyes watch; end card question
